content: {"reasoning":"Two corrections and a necessity appeal have already failed, all returning CO-50, and the diagnosis pairing (I25.10 with R00.2) is genuinely invalid per this payer, so further coding fixes or resubmissions would repeat prior failures. Medicare offers no retro-auth or peer-to-peer, so those paths are closed. Under Medicare, a service denied as not medically necessary cannot be balance-billed to the patient absent an ABN, so billing the patient would be improper. With no viable payer avenue remaining and no benefit from handing a dead-end to a hasty specialist, the balance should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
